text: As the Toronto Transit Commission (TTC) operates a transit service on Davenport Road, City Council approval of this report is required. Transportation Services is requesting approval to remove a designated on-street accessible loading zone on the south side of Davenport Road, between a point 19.8 metres west of Wiltshire Avenue (east leg) and a point 11 metres further west. The new occupants of the property do not require this space.

City Council on December 15, 16 and 17, 2021, adopted the following: 1. City Council rescind the existing on-street accessible loading zone in effect from 8:00 a.m. to 11:00 p.m., daily, on the south side of Davenport Road, between a point 19.8 metres west of Wiltshire Avenue (east leg) and a point 11 metres further west.
